body.summary: An AI-powered personal finance assistant ("Budget Yangu" means "My Budget" in Swahili). Helps users manage their finances through conversational AI, providing budgeting advice, expense tracking, and financial guidance. Conversations are stored as vCons for continuity and accountability.
